On 8 August 2025, the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders No. 1/2025 
of the Company approved an increase of the Company’s registered capital of Baht 1,280.5 million, 
from Baht 282.6 million to Baht 1,563.1 million.
The purposes of the share capital increase are as follows :
•Acquisition of World Industrial Estate Co., Ltd. 
• Investment in World Industrial Estate ( Lamphun ) Phase 2
• Working capital for business operations
During September 2025, the subscription period for the newly issued shares , the 
Company’s existing shareholders exercised their rights to subscribe for a total of 1,625,730,843 
new ordinary shares and fully paid the subscription amount totaling Baht 812.8 million. 
Subsequently , on 17 September 2025, the Company registered an increase in the paid -up 
share capital from Baht 282.6 million to Baht 1,095.4 million with the Department of Business 
Development, Ministry of Commerce.

## Page 6

We lift your life.6
Acquisition of the Ordinary Shares and Increase in Share Capital  
of World Industrial Estate Co., Ltd. 
On 8 August 2025, the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders No. 1/2025 
approved the acquisition of 1,700,000 ordinary shares of World Industrial Estate Co., Ltd., 
representing 100% of its registered and paid -up capital.
Subsequently , on 1 October 2025, the Company entered into a Share Purchase Agreement 
with World Corporation PCL and completed the full acquisition of 100% 
of the shares in World Industrial Estate Co., Ltd., amounting to Baht 370 million, 
and registered a capital increase of Baht 400 million .
Currently, the Company’s total investment in World Industrial Estate Co., Ltd. 
amounts to Baht 770 million.
